reviews.text: Verified a 14-inch mozzarella stick and one-pound pizza slice; praised the mozzarella stick, crispy-soft pizza bake, burger special, reasonable prices, and said he will definitely be back.
Called Frato's a hidden gem for comfort food lovers; highlighted the giant mozzarella stick, mac and cheese burger, gyro pizza, wings, thick milkshake, retro/chill vibe, and checkerboard table game.
First-time family visit; food took time because it was made fresh, portions were insane, vibe was chill, entertainment and games helped the wait, and staff were friendly.

Drove 35 minutes after hearing the hype; praised super delicious creative food, caring staff, online ordering ahead, custom pizzas, burgers, giant mozzarella sticks, burger of the month, and Ditka sausage pizza.
Ordered tenders, wings, and pizza; said everything was great, ghost pepper wings are the real deal, pizza was cooked perfectly, and Frato's will be her go-to.
Food came out together, well-cooked and warm; service was good, pickup-at-counter system was clear, atmosphere was nice, games were available, gambling booths were present, and restaurant was clean.
Loved the mozzarella sticks, friendly staff, welcoming first experience, and said he will be back; recommended huge handmade mozzarella sticks and the one-pound pizza slice.
Praised pizza fries and the Sunday giant mozzarella stick; mentioned slots while waiting and specifically recommended the mozzarella stick on Sundays.
Atmosphere was chill, music had a relaxed vibe, workers were polite, food was delicious, and the Sunday 13-inch mozzarella stick was memorable.
First visit did not disappoint; mozzarella sticks were crispy and gooey with marinara, the 'I'm Fat' grilled cheese was cooked perfectly, and they cannot wait to come back.
Called it one of the best pizza spots around with crispy crust, gooey cheese, fresh toppings, homemade sauce, great burgers/shakes/apps, fast service, affordable prices, games, and great vibes.
Pizza was great, mozzarella sticks were amazing, and the burger of the month was a standout.
Highlighted the Sunday giant mozzarella stick, cool place, and culinary chef training angle.
Food was amazing for a good price; mozzarella sticks are a must, mac and cheese is recommended, pizza slice was massive, and quality plus quantity were both strong.
Said the internet buzz is true, everything from food to staff is amazing, and urged people to get the cheese sticks for the cheese pull.
Praised seriously good handmade fresh food down to potato wedges; said a barbecue chicken grilled cheese weighed about a pound and blew his mind.
Called Frato's the new gyros go-to; praised grilled gyro meat, plentiful portion, warm pita, balanced tzatziki, and ooey-gooey mac and cheese.
Good relaxing place with nice interior, chill crew, fantastic food, and an incredible tzatziki sauce on the gyro.
Food was absolutely delicious, staff was very friendly, first visit made her want to return, and the quesabirria burger was memorable.
Paper menu led to a visit; praised mac and cheese with grilled mushrooms, sweet and tangy sauce, gyro sandwich, vintage Corvette mural, and said they would come back.
Giant cheese sticks were good and preferred over the humongous taco-style stick; noted the inside feels more family diner than the window coverings suggest.
Viral mozzarella stick brought the family in; praised amazing deals, sweet staff, games/checkers, delicious food, standout mac and cheese, and pizza.
Long-time customers who are consistently satisfied; pizza and crust are always great, menu has many options, and brownies are a recommended finish.
Good range from pizza to burgers and appetizers, big serving sizes, kind staff, quick food, and strongly recommended mozzarella sticks near Woodfield Mall.
Food and service are always on point; fresh, flavorful, strong portions and prices, and never disappointed.
Loved the cheese pull on mozzarella sticks, great pizza, and friendly staff.
Excellent service, fresh ingredients, interesting menu, and recommended favorites including burgers, pizza, and mozzarella sticks.
Updated to five stars after returning; pizza is really good, staff is good, the one-pound slice looked amazing, and phone/in-person service was friendly.
Food and atmosphere were amazing; praised Alex for being welcoming and making sure food is up to par.
Recommended it for Chicago-area Saturday nights; food is well cooked, service is amazing, the place has a cool vintage feel, and it works for families and friends.
